changelog:
⚡ What's New & Fixed in v1.7.5:

• 🎙️ Flawless Audio & Speech Continuity: Eliminated jitter prebuffer deadlocks and premature watchdog triggers in AudioEngine for seamless, natural voice turns.

• 💬 WhatsApp Voice Reading & Replying: Added real-time notification parsing and hands-free voice replies through Gemini Live.

• 🌐 Multi-Tab & Productivity Automation: Enhanced browser automation, clipboard reading, and safe background standby transitions.

• 🔮 Audio-Reactive 3D Orb: Dynamic real-time pulsation and visual feedback synced to speech amplitude across all themes.
